sources.label: Patches for morphe
sources.author: Hooman
patch_list: Turns on the built-in call recorder in regions where Google normally hides it. Recordings stay on your phone. Recording calls is regulated in many places, so check what is allowed where you live before using it.

Report a rejected DroidGuard broker connection as DEVELOPER_ERROR instead of crashing a renamed clone. Device testing required.
